sections.text:
Experience: (September 2021 - Present) Software Engineer II – J.P Morgan Services India Private Ltd. Project: Data management
efficient data processing and storage.
Backend development to map message flow for database insertion. • Cross collaboration with product managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to align on development plan.
Designed and integrated RESTful Web Services for various applications. • Root cause analysis and operational support for the products. • Responsible for writing acceptance test and unit test for the currencies persisted to queue. • Experience with Agile development methodologies (like Scrum). • Good working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence.
(May 2020 – September 2021) Software Engineer – Xiaomi Technology India Private Ltd. Project: Offline Sales System • Developed multiple modules using spring boot and AngularJS for an application which is used by
Xiaomi store managers and sells personals. Services & Controllers development using Spring Boot for the web application.
• Root cause analysis and operational support for the products. • Owned the delivery of developed modules and features for the web application. • Cross calibration with Product Managers and Engineers to align on development plan and execution.
(September 2017 – April 2020) Software Engineer - Profinch Solutions Pvt. Ltd Project: FinFlowz (Digital Banking Workflow System)
Boot App and Angular6 for building user interface. Involved in Writing the Services & Controllers using Spring Boot.
• Used XSLT to transform XML to JSON and vice-versa. • Responsible for production support, analyzing the root cause of the issue and fixing the issue by deploying the code in the production environment through business approvals.
Worked with Geographically distributed team.
Trainee:
6 Months of Internship as Java Developer in Profinch Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
